{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Americans of every political stripe are hungry for a new kind of government.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The government will favor common sense over ideology, honesty over spin, and worry less about losing the next election and more about winning the battles owed to the next generation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Over 30,000 Americans attended 1645 local platform hearings, demonstrating their commitment to reasserting government of, by, and for the people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Millions of Americans turned out in primaries and caucuses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A record-breaking number of Americans abroad participated, including men and women who serve in the military.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats want to continue the momentum of the election.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Only by continuing the momentum of the election can the change necessary to restore the promise of America be brought.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The government will open up democracy to the people and protect civil liberties.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The government will invite the service and participation of American citizens.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The government will use the tools of government and technology to lead into a new era of connectedness, teamwork, and progress.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A Barack Obama Administration will make it clear to special interests that their days of setting the agenda in Washington are over.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The American people are not the problem in the 21st century—they are the solution.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Every vote will count, because everyone's voice matters in the political process in America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
